title: Cockpit Swarm
tagline: Strafe the rail. Clear the swarm. Hold the sector.
description: A first-person cockpit fixed-shooter: strafe along a rail to dodge incoming fire and shoot down enemy formations advancing from the horizon across fifteen stages, five power-ups, and three bosses. Play the campaign, Boss Rush, Boss Practice, or a 1v1 Dodgeball duel online.
status: Playable — 15-stage campaign, 3 bosses, Boss Rush/Practice, and online 1v1 Dodgeball
